caption:
Boxed GTA VI copies come with a code instead of a disc. The AI picks predate the launch: Claude says PS5 Slim with disc, GPT says PS5 Pro, and the Pro only pays off on a 4K HDMI 2.1 TV. Every pick by need: 1billionmodels.com

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice. AI-made video.
title: Buying a PS5 for GTA VI? Disc, Digital or Pro
